title: No secret scanning in CI; stop-gap history scan found no live secrets
expected: A secret scanner (gitleaks/trufflehog or GitHub secret scanning with push protection) runs on every push and PR over full history.
actual: No scanner in CI. This audit's 15-rule scan of all 76 available commits found 12 database-URL hits: all placeholders except the documented local Docker Compose dev password. Docs also show what appears to be the real Supabase project hostname (not a secret, but it names the production database host). The clone is shallow, so older history is not covered.
impact: A future committed key would not be caught before reaching main.
fix: Enable GitHub secret scanning + push protection and add a gitleaks job (pinned by SHA) with fetch-depth: 0; replace the real project hostname in docs with a placeholder.
